panels.title: Estimated cost per day, by team (USD)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_trunc('day', u.created_at) AS time, COALESCE(t.name, 'no team') AS metric,
  SUM((u.input_tokens * p.input_per_mtok + u.output_tokens * p.output_per_mtok
  + u.cache_read_tokens * p.cache_read_per_mtok + u.cache_write_tokens * p.cache_write_per_mtok) / 1000000
  + u.web_searches * p.per_thousand_searches / 1000) AS value
FROM usage_aiusage u
JOIN usage_modelprice p ON p.model = u.model
LEFT JOIN families_team t ON t.id = u.team_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(u.created_at)
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Estimated cost per day, by feature (USD)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_trunc('day', u.created_at) AS time, u.feature AS metric, SUM((u.input_tokens * p.input_per_mtok + u.output_tokens * p.output_per_mtok
  + u.cache_read_tokens * p.cache_read_per_mtok + u.cache_write_tokens * p.cache_write_per_mtok) / 1000000
  + u.web_searches * p.per_thousand_searches / 1000) AS value
FROM usage_aiusage u JOIN usage_modelprice p ON p.model = u.model
WHERE $__timeFilter(u.created_at)
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT date_trunc('hour', created_at) AS time, model AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value
FROM usage_aiusage WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT COALESCE(t.name, 'no team') AS team, u.model, COUNT(*) AS calls,
  SUM(u.input_tokens) AS input_tokens, SUM(u.output_tokens) AS output_tokens,
  SUM(u.web_searches) AS web_searches, ROUND(SUM((u.input_tokens * p.input_per_mtok + u.output_tokens * p.output_per_mtok
  + u.cache_read_tokens * p.cache_read_per_mtok + u.cache_write_tokens * p.cache_write_per_mtok) / 1000000
  + u.web_searches * p.per_thousand_searches / 1000)::numeric, 4) AS cost_usd
FROM usage_aiusage u
LEFT JOIN usage_modelprice p ON p.model = u.model
LEFT JOIN families_team t ON t.id = u.team_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(u.created_at)
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY cost_usd DESC NULLS LAST
